lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੜੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar gaR kot hai sabh disa(n)tar desaa ||
lines.translation: Deep within the body is the fortress of the Lord, and all lands and countries.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape taaRee laaeean sabh mahi paravesaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself sits in primal, profound Samaadhi; He Himself is all-pervading.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖੇਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape srisat saajeean aap gupat rakhesaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself created the Universe, and He Himself remains hidden within it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਗਟੀਏਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te jaaniaa sach paragateeesaa ||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, the Lord is known, and the Truth is revealed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh sacho sach hai gur sojhee paaee ||16||
lines.translation: He is True, the Truest of the True; the Guru has imparted this understanding. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਅਹਾੜੁ ਦਿਹੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਖੇਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: saavan raat ahaaR dihu kaam krodh dui khet ||
lines.translation: Night is the summer season, and day is the winter season; sexual desire and anger are the two fields planted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਦਰੋਗੁ ਬੀਉ ਹਾਲੀ ਰਾਹਕੁ ਹੇਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: lab vatr darog beeu haalee raahak het ||
lines.translation: Greed prepares the soil, and the seed of falsehood is planted; attachment and love are the farmer and hired hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਲੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਣ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਖਟੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hal beechaar vikaar man hukamee khate khaai ||
lines.translation: Contemplation is the plow, and corruption is the harvest; this is what one earns and eats, according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਅਉਤੁ ਜਣੇਦਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak lekhai ma(n)giai aut janedaa jaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when one is called to give his account, he will be barren and infertile. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਭੁਇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਬਲੇਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhau bhui pavit paanee sat sa(n)tokh baled ||
lines.translation: Make the Fear of God the farm, purity the water, truth and contentment the cows and bulls,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਲੁ ਹਲੇਮੀ ਹਾਲੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਚੇਤਾ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਵਖਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hal halemee haalee chit chetaa vatr vakhat sa(n)jog ||
lines.translation: humility the plow, consciousness the plowman, remembrance the preparation of the soil, and union with the Lord the planting time.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਬੋਹਲ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਦਰੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: naau beej bakhasees bohal duneeaa sagal darog ||
lines.translation: Let the Lord's Name be the seed, and His Forgiving Grace the harvest. Do this, and the whole world will seem false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree karam hoi jaavahi sagal vijog ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if He bestows His Merciful Glance of Grace, then all your separation will be ended. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh mohu gubaar hai doojai bhaai bolai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is trapped in the darkness of emotional attachment; in the love of duality he speaks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai sadaa dukh hai nit neer virolai ||
lines.translation: The love of duality brings pain forever; he churns the water endlessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢੋਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaaeeai math tat kadholai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he churns, and obtains the essence of reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਧਾ ਟੋਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar paragaas ghat chaananaa har ladhaa tolai ||
lines.translation: The Divine Light illuminates his heart deep within; he seeks the Lord, and obtains Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: aape bharam bhulaaidaa kichh kahan na jaaee ||17||
lines.translation: He Himself deludes in doubt; no one can comment on this. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak chi(n)taa mat karahu chi(n)taa tis hee hei ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, don't be anxious; the Lord will take care of you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਰੋਜੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal mahi ja(n)t upaaian tinaa bh rojee dei ||
lines.translation: He created the creatures in water, and He gives them their nourishment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਹਟੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਰਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: othai hat na chalaee naa ko kiras karei ||
lines.translation: There are no stores open there, and no one farms there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਉਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saudaa mool na hovaee naa ko lae na dei ||
lines.translation: No business is ever transacted there, and no one buys or sells.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਅ ਖਾਣਾ ਏਹੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeaa kaa aahaar jee khaanaa ehu karei ||
lines.translation: Animals eat other animals; this is what the Lord has given them as food.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਸਾਇਰਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vich upaae saairaa tinaa bh saar karei ||
lines.translation: He created them in the oceans, and He provides for them as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak chi(n)taa mat karahu chi(n)taa tis hee hei ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, don't be anxious; the Lord will take care of you. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਝੀਵਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ihu jeeu machhulee jheevar trisanaa kaal ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, this soul is the fish, and death is the hungry fisherman.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਪੜੈ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manooaa a(n)dh na chetaee paRai achi(n)taa jaal ||
lines.translation: The blind man does not even think of this. And suddenly, the net is cast.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak chit achet hai chi(n)taa badhaa jaai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, his consciousness is unconscious, and he departs, bound by anxiety.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare je aapanee taa aape lae milaai ||2||
lines.translation: But if the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then He unites the soul with Himself. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: se jan saache sadaa sadaa jinee har ras peetaa ||
lines.translation: They are true, forever true, who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sachaa man vasai sach saudaa keetaa ||
lines.translation: The True Lord abides in the mind of the Gurmukh; He strikes the true bargain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਲੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh ghar hee maahi hai vadabhaagee leetaa ||
lines.translation: Everything is in the home of the self within; only the very fortunate obtain it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਗਈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar trisanaa mar gaee har gun gaaveetaa ||
lines.translation: The hunger within is conquered and overcome, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: aape mel milaaian aape dei bujhaaee ||18||
lines.translation: He Himself unites in His Union; He Himself blesses them with understanding. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਲਿ ਪਿੰਞਾਇਆ ਕਤਿ ਵੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: vel pi(n)njaaiaa kat vunaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The cotton is ginned, woven and spun;

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਖੁੰਬਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kat kut kar khu(n)b chaRaaiaa ||
lines.translation: the cloth is laid out, washed and bleached white.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਹਾ ਵਢੇ ਦਰਜੀ ਪਾੜੇ ਸੂਈ ਧਾਗਾ ਸੀਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lohaa vadhe darajee paaRe sooee dhaagaa seevai ||
lines.translation: The tailor cuts it with his scissors, and sews it with his thread.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਟੀ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸੀਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: iu pat paatee siphatee seepai naanak jeevat jeevai ||
lines.translation: Thus, the torn and tattered honor is sewn up again, through the Lord's Praise, O Nanak, and one lives the true life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਪਾਟੈ ਸੂਈ ਧਾਗਾ ਗੰਢੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi puraanaa kapaR paatai sooee dhaagaa ga(n)dhai ||
lines.translation: Becoming worn, the cloth is torn; with needle and thread it is sewn up again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਹੁ ਪਖੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੰਢੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maahu pakh kihu chalai naahee ghaRee muhat kichh ha(n)dhai ||
lines.translation: It will not last for a month, or even a week. It barely lasts for an hour, or even a moment.
